name: Lenvatinib + Pembrolizumab (IO + TKI, first-line clear-cell RCC)
cyclesNote: Continuous therapy: lenvatinib 20 mg PO once daily every day, plus pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks. Continued until progression or unacceptable toxicity; pembrolizumab generally capped at about 2 years.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Distinguish TKI toxicity (hypertension, diarrhea, fatigue, proteinuria) from immune-related effects.
Blood pressure monitoring and management; assess for proteinuria.
Immune-related adverse event counseling and prompt symptom reporting.
monitoring: immune toxicity screen (TSH/free T4, LFTs, glucose) as indicated

doseModificationRules.text: Hold lenvatinib and resume at a reduced dose (14 mg, then 10 mg, then 8 mg once daily) per labeling for persistent grade 3 toxicity.

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2 or higher immune-related adverse event
doseModificationRules.text: Hold pembrolizumab and manage with corticosteroids per immune-related adverse event guidance; obtain clinical review before rechallenge.

drugs.name: Lenvatinib
drugs.notes: Lenvatinib 20 mg PO once daily, continuous (shown across all cycle days), combined with pembrolizumab. Reduce for toxicity (14/10/8 mg). Authored from standard first-line clear-cell RCC practice (NCCN Kidney Cancer; CLEAR study supporting evidence).

drugs.name: Pembrolizumab
drugs.notes: Pembrolizumab 200 mg IV flat on day 1 of each 21-day cycle (400 mg every 6 weeks is a label-equivalent alternative). Combined with lenvatinib as first-line therapy. Authored from standard practice (CLEAR study).
